## Synopsis

Runs the server's activation checks on the named set's stored text and, when
they pass, publishes it in a new signed snapshot that every enforcement point
pulls. Only this set changes. Every other live set keeps the text it was last
published with, including edits saved to it and not published yet.
A refused check changes nothing and names what to fix.

```
strazactl policy activate <name> [flags]
```

## Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --server string   strazad base URL (overrides $STRAZA_SERVER and the server you logged into)
```
